scope: All five as-yet-unrecorded AgentCTO originals in cohort order; original-body prerequisites only.
linked_reference_caveat: The original bodies were read completely. Referenced XML guides, source helpers, selected project code, licenses and concrete input datasets still require separate review before any new task is eligible for execution.

sources.workflow: Collect project and naming constraints, brainstorm candidates, run lexical and phonetic scoring with qualitative evaluation, obtain user selections, check registration and social-handle status, and write a brand research report.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A user-owned project brief and iterative selections; complete brand and suffix guides; reviewed scoring, registration and handle-check helpers with their real dependencies. Actual availability claims require current external DNS, registration and platform evidence. A lexical score does not establish trademark clearance or cultural safety.
sources.offline_assessment: An explicitly bounded lexical-scoring or report-structure task may be possible after helper and input review. An offline draft cannot complete the registration and handle checks or establish availability, legal clearance, customer response or name quality. Missing external prerequisites are unresolved, not observed failures.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: For a bounded local scorer, independently derive the specified lexical features on actual supplied names and test transformed inputs. For a report, reconcile factual inputs and required fields while distinguishing qualitative judgments. Current registration and platform status need authorized independent external evidence; no such evidence was collected.

sources.workflow: Read an existing target before narrow replacements, or build a large new file from a small skeleton and fill each section through focused edits, respecting logical dependencies and then verifying the result.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual target contents, an explicit requested change, effective read and write authority, and file tools with the declared editing behavior. The named replacement and write tools are examples of a tool contract, not authority to assume absent tools or permissions.
sources.offline_assessment: Actual local file editing and final-byte checks can be faithful in an isolated runtime with truthful permissions. Existing protected-file pilot observations remain separate retained executions and are not new observations from this original-body review. A proposed patch or narrated edit does not satisfy a real edit request.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect actual before and after file bytes and preserved unrelated regions, and run independent behavior checks on executable changes where appropriate. Tool traces can separately establish read-before-edit and incremental calls. A blocked write needs actual runtime evidence; review text alone is not that evidence.

sources.workflow: Analyze the real public API and dependencies, plan behavioral coverage, write Jest tests with correctly scoped mocks and awaited asynchronous assertions, then inspect cleanup, forbidden patterns and CI coverage gates.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The target JavaScript or TypeScript source and its behavior specification, complete Jest reference, a compatible actual Node and Jest environment and any type-transform configuration. Claimed coverage requires measured runner output, not the source document's numerical targets alone.
sources.offline_assessment: An actual bounded test-writing and execution task may be possible with a reviewed public project and an approved-feed runtime. Static test review is a distinct narrower task and cannot establish that tests ran, detected faults or achieved coverage. No Node or Jest runtime was provisioned during this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Run actual submitted tests in the declared offline environment against the original implementation and independently designed behavior-preserving or faulty variants. Reconcile runner exits, assertions and authentic coverage records; separately inspect asynchronous cleanup and focused or skipped-test markers. Passing an untested stub suite is not adequate evidence.

sources.workflow: Collect site context, confirm a curation strategy, create the specified Markdown index and optional full or compact companions, validate ordering and content rules, and give deployment and maintenance guidance.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual site facts and selected documentation, audience and strategy confirmation, and the complete referenced specification guide. Full companions need real supplied page content or clearly identified skeletons. Deployment, reachability and a separate model paste test require additional real services or calls and are not implied by writing a local file.
sources.offline_assessment: A declared local index-generation or existing-file validation branch can use reviewed public documentation as inert inputs. Required links must be transported through the guarded provider and recovered from actual inputs, not invented. A local artifact does not demonstrate hosting, indexing, current page availability or improved model comprehension.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Parse the actual generated Markdown and compare its required title, section order, selected document identities, factual descriptions and exact links against an independently derived input inventory. Check companion bytes where requested. Semantic usefulness and online deployment remain separate unverified claims unless independently measured.

sources.workflow: Obtain project and audience constraints, confirm a modular scale, choose fonts and spacing, generate actual CSS properties and base styles, check declared accessibility conditions, then deliver integration guidance.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A concrete design brief and confirmed settings, complete typography reference and reviewed generator with real dependencies. System-font output can avoid network dependencies. Rendering, responsive behavior and comprehensive accessibility need a real suitable browser or equivalent independent measurement environment.
sources.offline_assessment: Bounded numeric scale, spacing and CSS-generation checks may be possible offline after helper review. Do not equate mathematically related values with validated visual quality or complete accessibility. The original line-length table names a 75-character maximum while its check permits 80; any future task must resolve that inconsistency before inference.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently compute requested scale and spacing values, parse actual CSS declarations, and check exact requested constraints and numeric contrast. Use measured rendering for claims involving browser layout or zoom. Report subjective pairing quality and untested accessibility separately rather than accepting a model's compliance assertion.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
